question.text: If the circle <math><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>25</mn></math> intersects the circle <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn></math> in such a way that the length of the common chord is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn></math> units, then the value of <math><msup><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> is

solution.text:
The equation of the common chord is -2ax+a2+2by-b2=9
which passes through 0,b
i.e. 02+a2+2b2-b2=9

⇒a2+b2=9
